# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the latest version of PauseCat receives security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in PauseCat, please do not open a public issue. Instead, report it privately to the maintainer via GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature, or contact the developer directly.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide a timeline for resolution.
